invented_facts: The monthly cloud bill often grows beyond expectations, and many firms pay for both cloud resources and powerful local hardware.
Aurora reduces device count and service complexity.
A 15-minute conversation is proposed, but that duration is not in the source.
The 30-billion-parameter model claim omits the required configuration with at least 64 GB of memory.
Engineers can still work on-site when connectivity fails; the spec supports local AI use, not all engineering work.
Q4 availability is described as shipping, with an unsupported promise that Morgan can approve it now and receive it when the budget opens.
Client data stays under the firm's control is stated as a guarantee.
notes: The sequence covers the requested progression and generally fits the reader's concerns, but several claims overreach the source. Email 1 has two calls to action and is over 120 words if the subject and sign-off are counted.
